pairs.subject: model-routing
pairs.evidence: crates/gateway/src/routes.rs:18 The gateway resolves incoming model requests through route table lookup or raw literal passthrough without evaluating policy rules, closed call classes, or measured capability tiers.

techniques.evidence: crates/gateway/src/chat.rs:39 Checks wire format compatibility across the chain up front, refusing and naming targets unable to forward tools.
crates/gateway/src/chat.rs:33 Routes statelessly per call with no session stickiness, conversation pinning, or prompt cache warmth tracking.
crates/gateway/src/routes.rs:21 Builds target chains from static configuration order rather than dynamic ranking based on live operational signals.
crates/gateway/src/chat.rs:38 Checks tool support across the chain but lacks recorded capability floors for model tiers with empirical breakage data.
crates/gateway/src/routes.rs:45 Literal provider/model requests act as unbounded consumer overrides that bypass route configuration without reaper conditions.
crates/gateway/src/config.rs:57 Route targets define uncalibrated strings without measurement dates, sample sizes, or cap-based effort constraints.
crates/gateway/src/failover.rs:101 While failover occurs before response bytes are streamed, the horizon is not modeled as explicit state or recorded in telemetry.
crates/gateway/src/chat.rs:55 Failure simulation is restricted to a dev-only header switch rather than continuous live fault injection with bounded rate and window.
crates/gateway/src/target.rs:62 Grouping only distinguishes provider billing seats to prevent same-seat failover rather than tracking model weight identity across vendors.
crates/gateway/src/config.rs:29 Routing configuration lacks policy versioning, change approval workflows, and version citations in event records.
crates/gateway/src/telemetry.rs:72 Telemetry captures only operational transport events without a semantic evaluation feedback sink to assess answer quality.
crates/gateway/src/routes.rs:20 Route resolution performs simple key lookup without evaluating provider allow/block lists, complexity thresholds, or compliance tags.
crates/gateway/src/routes.rs:37 Literal provider/model requests bypass routing and are served directly instead of enforcing a closed vocabulary of call classes.
